title: Nimble Citrus Peruvian Beef Stir-fry
description: A bright and energizing Peruvian-style beef stir fry with citrusy lime and orange, served in a ti leaf wrap with pasta and fresh herbs.
instructions: Cook farfalle pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Add sliced beef sirloin to the skillet and sear until browned on all sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Push beef to the side and add sliced onion, bell pepper, and minced garlic, sautéing until vegetables soften, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and a splash of lime juice, then toss the beef back into the pan and cook until the beef is just cooked through, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked farfalle and squeeze the juice of one lime and one orange over the mixture, tossing to coat evenly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then remove from heat.
Spool the stir fry into ti leaf wraps, sprinkle with chopped cilantro, and fold for serving.
Serve immediately while hot, garnishing with additional cilantro if desired.
